title: Multidimensional scalar conservation laws with discontinuous flux: well-posedness without non-degeneracy
summary: We establish existence, uniqueness, and local \(L^1\)-stability for multidimensional scalar conservation laws with discontinuous heterogeneous flux, without imposing a non-degeneracy condition on the physical space--time flux. The discontinuity set may be a locally finite family of \(C^2\) hypersurfaces whose intersections and singular points are contained in a closed set of vanishing \((d-1)\)-dimensional Hausdorff measure.
